answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and joins a Semaphore membership tree under a hidden identity. It evaluates the epoch polynomial and derives an RLN rate-limit proof for every message; two messages with the same nullifier expose distinct Shamir shares, whose interpolation recovers the signing secret. The contract verifies this evidence and instantly slashes the bond, making sybil identities costly—ivory in theory, pulse-fast in response, and timber-solid in deterrence.
